description: This is a Swift source file defining the actor 'MacNodeRuntime', responsible for handling various commands and services within a macOS application context. It manages interactions like camera capture, canvas rendering, system commands, location access, screen recording, and external communication, using async/await patterns and actor-based concurrency.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing runtime commands, services, and interactions for a macOS node within a broader application, including camera, system, location, and UI services.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used for internal session management.

methods.name: setEventSender
methods.description: Sets an event sender callback for emitting asynchronous events.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main entry point to handle an incoming command request and dispatch to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: isCanvasCommand
methods.description: Checks if a command pertains to canvas operations.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to canvas operations such as present, hide, navigate, evalJS, and snapshot.

methods.name: handleA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands to push messages or reset A2UI interface.

methods.name: handleBrowserProxyInvoke
methods.description: Handles proxy requests to the browser component.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Manages camera-related commands: snap, clip, list devices.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location requests, retrieving current location and permissions.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Handles screen recording commands.

methods.name: mainActorServices
methods.description: Returns cached or newly created main actor services.

methods.name: handleA2UIReset
methods.description: Executes reset command for A2UI.

methods.name: handleA2UIPush
methods.description: Pushes messages to the A2UI interface.

methods.name: ensureA2UIHost
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI host page is loaded and reachable.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the URL for the A2UI host page.

methods.name: isA2UIReady
methods.description: Checks if A2UI is fully loaded and ready.

methods.name: handleSystemRun
methods.description: Handles execution of system commands, including approval flows and security checks.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Finds executable paths for given binaries.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunApproval
methods.description: Resolves whether a system command is approved, asking user if needed.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsGet
methods.description: Retrieves the current exec approval config snapshot.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsSet
methods.description: Sets the exec approvals configuration.

methods.name: emitExecEvent
methods.description: Emits an execution-related event via the configured event sender.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks for permissions if screen recording is needed, and emits deny events if permissions are missing.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
